{"source":"data","name":"paid_order_amount_by_region","sql":"SELECT c."region", SUM(o."amount") AS "total_paid_order_amount"
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON o."customer_id" = c."customer_id"
WHERE o."status" = 'paid'
  AND c."region" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(c."region") != ''
GROUP BY c."region""}
